say:1:1810360001:1.text: Rain! Let me take a look at you!
say:1:1810360001:1.source_cn: 里纳！快让老身看看你的情况！

say:3:1810360003:1.text: But why was I infected? Am I... not a Graveborn?
say:3:1810360003:1.source_cn: 我为什么会被赤烛蕊感染？难道我……我不是亡灵？

say:7:1810360006:1.text: <style="highlight">I can't remember a thing before I came to Novaris</style>. From the moment I had memory, I've been working for Baba.

choice_prompt:8:1810360006.text: <style="highlight">I can't remember a thing before I came to Novaris</style>. From the moment I had memory, I've been working for Baba.
choice_prompt:8:1810360006.source_cn: <style=highlight>我只记得来到诺珐斯以后的事</style>，从有记忆开始，我就在给婆婆工作了。

say:10:1810360008:1.text: Baba, please tell me the truth.
say:10:1810360008:1.source_cn: 婆婆，到底是怎么回事？你就告诉我吧。

say:11:1810360009:1.text: You are... <style="highlight">a Lightbearer war captive, meant to be converted into a Graveborn to serve Bantus in due time</style>...

say:13:1810360011:1.text: How did I lose my memory? You always told me it was a side effect of becoming a Graveborn...
say:13:1810360011:1.source_cn: 那我为什么会失忆？以前你都说是因为我变成了亡灵……

say:14:1810360012:1.text: Your memory was erased so you would forget your former life and devote yourself entirely to Bantus.
say:14:1810360012:1.source_cn: 洗去记忆，遗忘生前的一切，才能更好地为班题斯效力。

say:15:1810360013:1.text: I don't know exactly how it was done.
say:15:1810360013:1.source_cn: 至于具体方法，老身也不清楚。

choice_prompt:16:1810360013.text: I don't know exactly how it was done.
choice_prompt:16:1810360013.source_cn: 至于具体方法，老身也不清楚。

say:17:1810360014:1.text: Who cares about that right now? Saving Rain is our priority!
say:17:1810360014:1.source_cn: 这有何重要？！当务之急是救里纳！
say:17:1810360014:1.male: Who cares about that right now? Saving Rain is our priority!
say:17:1810360014:1.female: Who cares about that right now? Saving Rain is our priority!

say:18:1810360015:1.source_cn: 被赤烛蕊感染……不是不治之症吗？

say:19:1810360016:1.text: I don't know the cure, but <style="highlight">Lady Novaris</style> may know what to do...

say:20:1810360017:0.text: Lady Novaris once employed human servants at her estate, and some of them survived candle blossom infection. Her Ladyship must know how to treat it.
say:20:1810360017:0.source_cn: 十几年前，领主阁下的庄园内仍有生者血仆。老身曾亲眼见其...

say:21:1810360018:1.text: Rain, hang in there. I'll see her right away to get the cure for you!
say:21:1810360018:1.source_cn: 里纳，你要撑住。老身这就去面见领主，一定为你求来解药！

say:22:1810360019:1.text: Eveline needs it too! Baba, please help her. She's already passed out...
say:22:1810360019:1.source_cn: 艾芙琳也需要……！婆婆，你救救她吧，她已经昏厥了……

say:23:1810360020:1.text: It's up to the God of Death whether she can last until I get back.
say:23:1810360020:1.source_cn: 那就向死神祈求，但愿她能撑到老身回来吧。

say:24:1810360021:0.text: Meeting the ruler of Novaris is a great opportunity to learn something useful about Bantus!
say:24:1810360021:0.source_cn: 面见诺珐斯的领主——这是刺探情报的绝佳机会！如果幸运的...

say:25:1810360022:0.text: Douglas mentioned that <style="highlight">Lady Novaris once lived in the Gravebloom Fields</style>. Furthermore, <style="highlight">the danger posed by the candle blossoms appears to have been deliberately concealed</style>... Lady Novaris must have some connection to all of this.

choice_prompt:26:1810360022.text: Douglas mentioned that <style="highlight">Lady Novaris once lived in the Gravebloom Fields</style>. Furthermore, <style="highlight">the danger posed by the candle blossoms appears to have been deliberately concealed</style>... Lady Novaris must have some connection to all of this.
choice_prompt:26:1810360022.source_cn: 而且道格尔还曾言明，<style=highlight>苍骸花海是旧日领主庄园的所在地</style>，加之<style=highlight>被刻意隐瞒的赤烛蕊的危害</style>……这一切必定和诺珐斯领主脱不开干系。

say:27:1810360023:1.text: Fine. If the worst happens to me, you'll be able to bring the cure back.
say:27:1810360023:1.source_cn: 也罢。若是老身出了意外，至少你能把药剂带回来。
say:27:1810360023:1.male: Fine. If the worst happens to me, you'll be able to bring the cure back.
say:27:1810360023:1.female: Fine. If the worst happens to me, you'll be able to bring the cure back.

say:28:1810360024:0.text: Come. We're going to the <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>. The show just ended, and knowing Lady Novaris, she'll probably be hanging around there for a while.
say:28:1810360024:0.male: Come. We're going to the <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>. The show just ended, and knowing Lady Novaris, she'll probably be hanging around there for a while.
say:28:1810360024:0.female: Come. We're going to the <style="highlight">Seasong Theater</style>. The show just ended, and knowing Lady Novaris, she'll probably be hanging around there for a while.

choice:16:0:1.text: A human can be directly converted into a Graveborn?!
choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 班题斯还能将生者转化为亡灵？
choice:16:0:1.male: A human can be directly converted into a Graveborn?!
choice:16:0:1.female: A human can be directly converted into a Graveborn?!

choice:8:0:1.text: Baba, you owe Rain an explanation.
choice:8:0:1.male: Baba, you owe Rain an explanation.
choice:8:0:1.female: Baba, you owe Rain an explanation.

choice:8:1:2.text: No wonder you were so shocked when you found out.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 难怪你发现的时候那么惊讶
choice:8:1:2.male: No wonder you were so shocked when you found out.
choice:8:1:2.female: No wonder you were so shocked when you found out.

choice:8:2:3.text: I know how you feel. I lost my memory too.
choice:8:2:3.source_cn: 同病相怜，我也经常失忆
choice:8:2:3.male: I know how you feel. I lost my memory too.
choice:8:2:3.female: I know how you feel. I lost my memory too.

choice:6:0:1.text: Wait, you don't even know who you are?
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 等等，你连自己是谁都不知道？
choice:6:0:1.male: Wait, you don't even know who you are?
choice:6:0:1.female: Wait, you don't even know who you are?
